scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 criterion for extensions.osc5-special-color (OSC 5;0;? BEL answered by one complete OSC 5;0;rgb:h{1,4}/h{1,4}/h{1,4} frame ended by BEL or ST; a query-only probe that can never return unsupported), decided by the unchanged stock collector against the App in this owned run, corroborated by the exact-query witness (query policy v6) and replayed byte-exactly on both pinned paths over the journaled raw reply of its own fenced exchange, beside a separately identified effect contract graded by an independent oracle written from rxvt's special-color text: chained numeric selector/value pairs (0 bold, 1 underline, 2 blink, 3 reverse, 4 italic) over a five-slot resource set separate from the OSC 4 palette, the OSC 10-19 dynamic colors and the kitty OSC 21 keys (each direction pinned by its own set/read group with the other service's measured default), per-selector and bare OSC 105 resets, the numeric encodings, reply order and the ST terminator; numeric selectors 0-4 only, ignored unmodeled selectors, malformed pairs, the oversize cap, set-only silence and the default-foreground slot default are policy groups that never decide; raw replies and stored state, not rendering or painted pixels; no setting of named colors, rxvt OSC 106 color modes, remote/mux, Windows/Linux or common-harness claim.

cases.pinnedCriterion: OSC 5;0;? BEL answered by one complete ESC]5;0;rgb:h{1,4}/h{1,4}/h{1,4} frame ended by BEL or ST (case-insensitive); a prefixed capture without a complete frame is inconclusive (invalid-reply) and no frame is inconclusive (no-response); it can never be unsupported

effectContract.attribution: separately identified Ntilde effect contract; not the pinned probe

baseline-special.demand: the default of every special color is read back (five complete frames in selector order) and becomes the restoration oracle

pinned.demand: the exact pinned BEL-terminated request on the untouched default reports selector 0 as one complete OSC 5 frame ended by ST

setup-A.demand: special-color set A is written through OSC 5 and read back per slot

set-then-query.demand: a set and a query in one OSC 5 are answered with the new color

per-slot.demand: each of the five slots sets, queries and reads back independently

encodings.demand: the numeric encodings scale to the stored eight-bit color and the reply reports it with sixteen-bit channels

bel-terminated.demand: a request ended by BEL is answered by a reply ended by ST

two-sequences.demand: two OSC 5 queries in one request are answered by two replies in request order

reset-one.demand: OSC 105 with one selector resets exactly that slot to the default

reset-all.demand: a bare OSC 105 resets all five slots to the default

baseline-other.demand: the dynamic foreground, palette slot 1 and the kitty cursor read back through OSC 10, OSC 4 and OSC 21 and become the isolation oracle

cross-dynamic-set.demand: an OSC 10 foreground set does not change the OSC 5;0 readback

cross-dynamic-read.demand: an OSC 5;0 set does not change the OSC 10 readback

cross-palette-set.demand: an OSC 4 palette set (slot 200, unused by the seed) does not change the OSC 5;1 readback

cross-palette-read.demand: an OSC 5;1 set does not change the OSC 4 slot-200 readback

cross-kitty-set.demand: a kitty cursor set does not change the OSC 5;2 readback

cross-kitty-read.demand: an OSC 5;2 set does not change the OSC 21 cursor readback

restore.demand: after the special resets a set color reads back as the baseline

unrelated-selector.demand: a selector outside 0-4 (named or numeric) changes nothing and stays silent, and valid pairs in the same sequence still apply

malformed.demand: a malformed pair is ignored without disturbing the reply framing

set-only-silent.demand: an OSC 5 without a query is not answered

reset-noise.demand: OSC 105 ignores unknown selectors and resets the listed one

oversize-dropped.demand: an OSC 5 over 32768 characters is dropped whole: its set takes no effect

conclusion.scope: rxvt special colors (OSC 5/105) sets, queries and resets only: the pinned index-0 request, all five slots (bold, underline, blink, reverse, italic) set and read back through OSC 5, per-slot and bare OSC 105 resets, the numeric encodings, chained pairs, reply order and the ST terminator, and the separation from the OSC 4 palette, the OSC 10-19 dynamic colors and the kitty OSC 21 keys; numeric selectors 0-4 only, ignored unmodeled selectors, malformed pairs, the oversize cap and set-only silence are recorded policy; slots default to the default foreground and a stored special color is never render-applied; raw terminal state, no rendering or painted-pixel claim, and the pinned probe tests only the index-0 query
